opening.argument: The video directs viewers to join BitClub Network through a named website and promotes team placement tied to referred members’ purchases. It explains that a third referred purchaser automatically starts a second team, then describes commissions based on the purchaser’s team, including 15 percent for team one and 25 percent for a personally enrolled purchase in team three. The speaker also acknowledges that part of a payment was not paying out correctly. Although the stated mechanics provide that commissions are released after six Bitcoin-network confirmations, the reported payment error leaves fulfillment and timing unverified. These referral-based placement and tiered commission claims therefore present a recruitment compensation structure without establishing that the promised payouts operate as described.
